title: Day 1 of AI/Algo Trading (Paper) - Posting for accountability
author: Enzobevmax
selftext:
Day 1 in the books! Hoping to keep similar format for each day. Trying to add in quick facts to answer easy, repetitive questions.

I will also post descriptions of the top two performing setups for that day, for now, in picture form as we are all looking for more setups(myself included!) and I'm happy to share what I have.

**After today** I will be using a slightly different picture format to deliver the same information, Claude will auto-generate this for me. Just easier!

Thanks for all the feedback, support, and camaraderie!

**Today:** \[+$674\] across 5 day-trading accounts · Primary \[-$81\] · green streak \[0\]  
Best setup: \[Morning Momentum Pop, +$650\] (details in pic)

**Quick facts -** To hopefully answer quick questions

* **AI:** Claude (Opus 5.5) builds, tests and runs it
* **Broker:** Alpaca API, paper trading
* **Setups:** 108 (Currently) live, built on basic indicators (RSI, VWAP, volume / buy-sell pressure, gaps, opening range, prior-day highs and lows, ATR)
* **Setup Generator:** a bot that invents 10 new setups a night from those same indicators and trades them on its own paper account

Setup Life cycle

    Idea / Generator
     └─ 2-yr backtest (costs in)
         └─ Replay on real sessions
             └─ Testing 1 / 2 / Generator (paper)
                 └─ Primary (paper)
                     └─ Live $ (after a green streak)
    Losers: Primary → Testing → Graveyard

Stats Description

* **Avg R:** average profit per trade, in units of the risk taken. Costs, fees and slippage are already in. +0.5R = earns half its risk per trade.
* **Break-even win rate:** the win rate a setup needs just to not lose money. Beat it and you’re profitable.
* **Confidence (t):** how sure we are it isn’t luck. 2+ is solid; under 1 could be luck.

Fun stuff!
